nom: Avène Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Serum

avis.titre: Excellent quality product and working fine !!
avis.texte: The BeautyBio non-acid vitamin C removed most of the dark spots on my face, then full stop, so since Avene is a great brand made in France, I bought it hoping to get rid of the rest dark spots; however, Avene is for sensitive skin, which will be milder than any other one. So far, I believe it has been very slowly fading away the dark spots I still have. I don't mind the slow pace because I can feel the excellent quality of this product. I've been using it daily for less than a month and will probably buy it again.

This product requires consideration of the other products in your routine. I included this is my routine this morning and enjoyed the citrus scent and gentle feeling of the serum, but did experience some peeling. To my knowledge this is a water based product so beware users of skincare containing silicones THIS WILL PEEL if layered together. I experienced that this morning after layering another serum as prep for my makeup. If you arent willing to use other water-based products you will experience pilling so please double check your skincare before purchasing!!!!
I would 100% buy this serum again, there is a scent it doesnt bother me or my rosacea prone skin. Its gentle enough i can use it every am.

Absolutely love this serum! Been using it for 3 weeks now & my skin is significantly brighter. I see other reviews mentioning the fragrance, but I don't mind it at all; I actually love the smell. The serum has a milky consistency which I enjoy a lot.
She works. Feels great and does really well lightening up dark sun spots. Had to find something less expensive than Causalie and this is it.
I really like Avene products, but this one was a hard miss! It felt very sticky, film-like on my face, and pilled immediately when I applied my sunscreen. And I don't even wear a foundation.

I received a sample of this and loved it so I ordered a full size. I use it almost every night, depending on my skincare routine. Absorbs nicely, I can tell it has brightened my skin, and the smell is a nice light fresh scent. The price point is good, a little goes a long way which makes it even better. Will be a staple for my skincare routine.
I use this at night when I am not using the same brands retinal. I find that its working on dark spots to brighten.

avis.titre: Heavily perfumed and scent does NOT go away
avis.texte: I have no idea how this works long-term because I could not stand to wear it even one time. From the moment I put drops of this in my hand I noticed the perfume sent. I had hoped that like some other products that once you put it on the smell would disappear. That was not the case. I had to go wash my face an hour later because I could not stand the smell. I would not recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin or sensitive to strong smells/perfume.
I like the fragrance. Vit c without fragrance usually smells really rancid. Aka the ordinary or skinceuticals. So I'd rather have this one 🤣
I am extremely pleased with this product. I bought when it was on sale to try. It makes my skin feel smooth and tight. Would highly recommend adding to your routine.

The Vitamin Active Cg Radiance Concentrated Serum is one of the best products I've tried so far. It is perfect for my aging skin.

avis.titre: Perfect Vitamin C Serum for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I love this serum! I use it all over my face and neck -- including around my eyes -- for glowing, protected skin with zero irritation. I follow with the Hydrance Aqua Gel, which I also apply around my eyes, and my skin hasn't look this soft, plump, and luminous in years. They both have a very mild, pleasant scent that dissipates very quickly and causes no irritation to my highly reactive skin.

I like it! It leave me the skin shinier and I start noticing less wrinkles and mark then before. The first time I applied it it burned a little, but it was just that occasion and on a few occasions that I have a pimple. Maybe if you have sensitive skin, you could first consult a dermatologist or do a test on your neck before buying it.
